Question: assalamoalaikum ham maszid me eco sound lagana chahate hai azaan k liye jisme baaz gaz tak aati hai(gunjne vaali aisa molana ne bataya hai) kya aisa speaker maszid me laga sakte hai azaan k liye? Answer ID: 15508 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1391/1391=M/1430) It is not good to have such a speaker. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
